talents.desc: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by 30% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were 3 levels higher.

talents.name: Savage Fury
talents.desc: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Feral Charge
talents.desc:
Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

talents.desc: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 6%.

talents.name: Predatory Strikes

talents.name: Lacerate
talents.desc: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 20 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

talents.name: Predatory Discipline
talents.desc: Your Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy.

talents.name: Blood Frenzy
talents.desc: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Leader of the Pack
talents.desc: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within 45 yards by 3%.

talents.name: Natural Instinct
talents.desc: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Rend and Tear
talents.desc: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 3%.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.desc: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.desc: Increases your Defense Skill by 8.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap

talents.name: Last Stand
talents.desc: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

talents.name: Master of Defense

talents.name: Defiance

talents.name: Vanguard

talents.name: Improved Shield Wall

talents.name: Hack and Slash
talents.desc:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

    melee attacks have a 1% chance
    to trigger an extra attack on the 
    target.

    Dagger/Fist: Increases your
    critical strike chance by 1%.

    Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of
    your target's armor.

talents.desc: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 4% of your maximum Mana.  May only occur once every 3 sec.

talents.desc: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 4 sec. Additionally, Holy Strike now strikes with your shield, triggering your active Holy Shield and Shield Specialization talents without consuming their charges or triggering their cooldowns, and allowing you to Block spells for 6 sec.
